summary: Reduce voice startup latency, protect the first word, and restore meaningful activity dots.
features: Start the first speech request from an earlier phrase boundary while preserving every word.
Remember Speak replies independently for each chat across devices, using Settings only as the default for new conversations.
Use lightweight persisted-data revisions to detect meaningful tab changes from chat tools, background workers, other devices, and the local interface.
Monitor Chat, Shared Files, Plugins, Automations, Notifications, Settings, and Developer data without observing routine DOM rendering.
fixes: Reduce the delay between streamed response text and voice playback.
Buffer a small amount of MP3 audio before playback to prevent first-word clipping.
Restore orange activity dots after browser-only semantic hooks missed external and background changes.
Exclude volatile sensor-observation bookkeeping from Automation activity revisions.
Clear tool activity, response timing, and completed status when a new chat starts.
Prevent a chat-specific Speak replies change from modifying the global default or other conversations.
Preserve Watchlist deduplication and Telegram Bot plain-text WebSocket delivery.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
